_ordering_rationale: PV decroissante : Storage Rental (revenu recurrent type immobilier, modele REIT), Service Revenue (croissance ALM/digital), CA total, Data Center capacity (asset class structurellement en hypercroissance).

kpis.signal: Revenu locatif recurrent type immo, durabilite legendaire (>15 ans retention), pilote du modele REIT
kpis.description_fr: Storage Rental : revenu locatif des centres de stockage physique + data centers. Recurrent (contrats 1-5 ans physique, 10.6 ans moyenne DC). 730M+ pieds cubes stockes FY24.
kpis.description_en: Storage Rental: recurring rental revenue from physical storage + data center facilities. Recurring (1-5 yr physical, 10.6 yr avg DC). 730M+ cubic feet stored FY24.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance via acquisition Regency Technologies (ALM), digital solutions
kpis.description_fr: Service Revenue : ALM (asset lifecycle management), digital, services. Boost FY24 via acquisition Regency Technologies (+137M$). ALM = nouveau growth engine post-2022.
kpis.description_en: Service Revenue: ALM (asset lifecycle management), digital, services. FY24 boost via Regency Technologies acquisition (+$137M). ALM = new growth engine post-2022.

kpis.description_fr: CA total Iron Mountain = Storage + Service. Acceleration nette FY24 (+12.2%) vs FY23 (+7.4%).
kpis.description_en: Total Iron Mountain revenue = Storage + Service. Clear FY24 acceleration (+12.2%) vs FY23 (+7.4%).

kpis.signal: 416 MW leasable + 864 MW en construction/developpement, pipeline AI-data centre majeur

kpis.description_en: Data Center leasable capacity at 12/31/2024: 416 MW. Additional pipeline: 864 MW under construction or development. Global Data Center segment = hypergrowth, AI tailwind.
